title: Frozen Decaf Nonfat Mocha Coffee Drink

content.title: About
content.content: Frozen decaf nonfat mocha coffee drink is a refreshing beverage made from low‑fat milk, chocolate flavor, and natural coffee aroma, but without caffeine. Served as a thick, ice‑cream‑like drink, it is perfect for those who want the taste of mocha without stimulation.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The decaffeinated version retains the classic mocha flavor while containing no caffeine.
Low‑fat formulation makes it suitable for reduced‑fat diets.
The drink is frozen to a soft‑serve consistency, allowing it to be enjoyed as both a dessert and a cool beverage.
Chocolate flavor often intensifies during freezing, creating a richer taste.
Often used in cafés as a base for non‑alcoholic coffee‑based cocktails.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The reduced‑fat content helps control calorie intake, supporting healthy weight management.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The milk base provides calcium essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Antioxidants from cocoa
items.content: Chocolate contributes flavonoids that may support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Caffeine‑free
items.content: Absence of caffeine makes it safe for children, pregnant individuals, and those sensitive to stimulants.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: High water content in the frozen form helps maintain hydration when consumed in moderation.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Contains milk, so people with lactose intolerance should choose lactose‑free alternatives.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein may cause reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Added sugar may be present for flavor; those monitoring blood glucose should be aware.

items.title: Cold temperature
items.content: The very cold product can cause discomfort for people with sensitive teeth or when consumed immediately after a hot meal.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the frozen mocha in a glass or cup; optionally top with whipped cream, grated chocolate, or nuts. For a twist, swirl in fruit puree to create new flavor combinations.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in the freezer at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. After opening, consume within 1–2 weeks to maintain texture and flavor. Do not store at room temperature, as the product will melt and lose quality.
